title: December central bank rate cuts take 2024 easing push to historic level
text:
December central bank rate cuts take 2024 easing push to historic level | Reuters

LONDON, Jan 7 (Reuters) - Major central banks in December delivered their biggest policy easing push since the spring 2020 COVID rate-cutting frenzy, with the latest moves making the annual 2024 easing effort the biggest in 15 years as policymakers brace for unsteady times.

Among central banks overseeing the 10 most heavily traded currencies, five of the nine that held meetings in December cut interest rates. Central banks in Switzerland and Canada shaved off 50 basis points (bps) each, while the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and Sweden's Riksbank trimmed benchmarks by 25 bps each.
